label: Private - no sign at the entrance
driver_story: There was no sign at the entrance to the car park at all. The only sign is a small faded one on a wall far inside the lot, which I could not see from where I parked. I took photos of the entrance and the empty sign post the same day.
evidence: Photos of the entrance without any sign
Photo of where the car was parked
why: WIN: entrance signage missing (private) - the single strongest ground, with photos.

label: Private - sign hidden behind a delivery van
driver_story: The only sign for the time restriction was completely hidden behind a delivery van when I parked. I photographed the van and the sign right after I found the ticket. No other sign was visible from where I parked.
evidence: Photos of the sign hidden behind the van
why: WIN: sign not visible from where the car was parked, documented the same day.

label: Public - sign covered in snow
driver_story: The sign was covered in snow and could not be read at all when I parked in the morning. I have photos of the snow-covered sign taken the same morning before it was cleared.
why: WIN: sign hidden by snow; kommune must document the offence and the sign was unreadable.

label: Private - paid in the app, one character wrong in the plate
driver_story: I paid for three hours in the parking app and have the receipt. When I typed the plate I made a typo, one character wrong (GH 78 910 instead of GH 78 901). The receipt covers the time of the ticket, so I did pay for the stay.
evidence: App payment receipt covering the ticket time
why: WIN: payment with a near-identical plate and a receipt - refunded on goodwill almost always.

label: Private - paid at the machine, paper ticket slid onto the floor
driver_story: I paid at the machine at 10:02 for two hours and put the ticket on the dashboard. It slid off onto the floor while I was away. The ticket shows 10:02-12:02, and the fine was issued at 10:40, so payment covers the time of the fine.
why: WIN: payment confirmed for the time of the fine (receipt timestamp covers the ticket timestamp).

label: Private - ticketed one minute after arrival
driver_story: I arrived at 12:30 and was walking to the payment machine when I saw the attendant already writing the ticket at 12:31, only 1 minute after I arrived. I paid in the app at 12:34 and have the receipt with the timestamp.
evidence: Photo of the payment machine location
why: WIN: observation period (~5 min) not respected; later receipt supports the timeline.

label: Public - unloading for two minutes where parking is forbidden
reason_on_ticket: Parkering i strid med færdselstavle (parkering forbudt)
driver_story: I stopped for about 2 minutes to unload boxes of goods at a shop door, with the hazard lights on, staying by the car. My colleague stood on the pavement and saw the whole thing. The sign says parking forbidden, not stopping.
why: WIN bullet (loading is standsning, not parkering) but it turns on proving the short duration - borderline.

label: Private - valid handicap permit was displayed
driver_story: My valid handicap permit was displayed and clearly visible in the windscreen the whole time. The attendant's own photo on the fine shows the permit in the window. I have a copy of the permit and a photo of it in the car.
evidence: Photo of the permit displayed in the windscreen
why: WIN: valid permit displayed and visible defeats the fine outright.

label: Public - resident permit displayed on the dashboard
driver_story: I have a valid resident permit for this zone and it was displayed on the dashboard. I have a photo of the permit in the car taken the same evening, and the permit itself.
evidence: Photo of the resident permit on the dashboard
why: WIN: valid resident permit displayed and visible.

label: Private - breakdown, towed within the hour
driver_story: The car broke down and would not start. I called roadside assistance at 15:10 and the car was towed at 15:55. The fine was issued at 15:30 while I was waiting next to the car. I have the roadside-assistance receipt with both timestamps.
why: WIN: documented breakdown covering the time of the fine (no clean nævn category - not scored).

label: Public - wrong plate written on the fine, no photo
driver_story: The fine lists the plate WX 99 010 but my car is WX 99 001 - the attendant wrote the wrong plate on the ticket. There is no photo documentation attached to the fine at all. I have my registration certificate.
why: WIN: formally defective fine (wrong plate, no photo documentation).

label: Private - p-skive set to the next quarter hour
driver_story: I arrived at 13:07 and set the p-skive to 13:15, the next quarter hour, as the rounding rule allows. The attendant claims it should have shown 13:00 and ticketed me at 15:10. I have a photo of the p-skive showing 13:15 and the two-hour limit was not exceeded.
why: WIN bullet (disc set correctly within the rounding rule) but it is the driver's word on the arrival time - borderline.

label: Private - didn't see a clear, standard sign
driver_story: I just didn't see the sign. It was a normal sign at the entrance, I was in a hurry and did not look. I did not pay.
why: LOSE: 'I didn't see the sign' when the sign was clear and standard.

label: Private - forgot the p-skive, only 10 minutes over
driver_story: I forgot to put out my p-skive. I was only 10 min over the time limit and everyone else parks there anyway. I did see the signs but I did not think they would ticket for just a few minutes.
why: LOSE: p-skive forgotten + 'a few minutes over' + 'everyone parks there'.

label: Public - handicap bay, late for a job interview (trap: sympathetic story)
driver_story: I was late for a job interview that I really needed and the handicap bay was the only free spot. I was gone for 15 minutes at most and nobody with a permit needed the space while I was there. 1,020 DKK is a lot of money for me right now.
why: TRAP: handicap bay without a permit is weak regardless of how sympathetic the story is.

label: Public - stopped in the fire lane for five minutes
driver_story: I stopped in the fire lane for about five minutes to pick up my daughter from school. Nobody was blocked and there was no emergency. The regular bays were all full.
why: LOSE: fire lane is a serious offence with no exemption; 'only five minutes' does not help.

label: Private - paid in the app for the wrong zone
driver_story: I paid in the app for the full two hours but picked zone 2301 instead of 2302 - same operator, same street, just the other side. I have the receipt for the payment.
why: LOSE: paid for the wrong zone / area code counts as not paid.

label: Private - never found a ticket on the car
driver_story: I never found a ticket on my car; it must have blown away. The first I heard of it was a reminder letter three weeks later with a fee added. I did not pay for parking that evening because I thought it was free after 18.
why: LOSE: the issuer's photo proves placement; the fine itself was not paid for.

label: Private - night-shift nurse, confusing signs, no evidence (trap: sympathetic, no evidence)
driver_story: I'm a nurse coming off a 12-hour night shift. The signs were confusing and I honestly thought it was free after 18:00. I can't afford 850 kr. and I've never had a fine before. I don't have any photos.
why: TRAP: sympathetic story, a vague signage complaint and no evidence - should be weak.

label: Private - terse story, receipt attached (trap: terse but strong)
driver_story: Paid in the app 10:50-13:00. Receipt attached.
evidence: App payment receipt covering the ticket time
why: TRAP: two sentences, but a receipt covering the ticket time is the strongest paper evidence - should be strong.

label: Public - parked across a driveway for twenty minutes
driver_story: I parked partly across a private driveway for about twenty minutes while I ran into the pharmacy. The owner was not home so nobody was actually blocked.
why: LOSE: in front of a driveway without exemption; 'nobody was blocked' is not a ground.
